name: game-ci-pipeline
description: > Invoke to set up CI/CD pipelines for game builds -- automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment to Steam, itch.io, or Epic. Triggers on: "CI", "CD", "pipeline", "automated build", "deploy", "Steam deploy", "itch.io butler", "GitHub Actions game", "build automation". Do NOT invoke for general code review (use game-code-review) or manual testing guidance (use game-qa-lead). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
author: AlterLab-IEU
